column1: # Proposed default capacities for jazzy interface packages over rmw_tickle (TickLE Plan, 2026-09-24).
# Research seed for the shipped per-package capacity files (rmw_tickle/PLAN.md, standard-message
# milestone). Validated by p2_apply_capacities.py, which annotates copies of the .msg/.srv files
# and runs the real generator front end over them.
# Budget: 1444 B per message (tt_MAX_BUFFER_LENGTH 1472 - 28 framing). A plain string counts as its
# 2-byte prefix only; rules below reserve ~24-40 B per string in practice, by choosing counts with
# Rules, in the order they were applied:
#   parallel   - arrays ROS defines to be the same length share one count (JointState, LaserScan,
#   structural - descriptor arrays that are small by nature (MultiArrayLayout.dim, PointCloud2.fields,
#   payload    - the message's main data array takes what is left, rounded down
#   element    - a type used as an array element elsewhere keeps its own arrays small, because a
#                capacity is global per type and every container pays for it
#   rcl        - rcl_interfaces keeps the values already in rcl_interfaces_rmw_tickle.patch (CI-proven)

column5: Point is 24 B; 44 under max_wire_size's conservative per-element padding
